title: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire have killed 30 around Gaza City, local officials say
summary: Toll includes 13 people trying to get food near distribution point, as Israeli cabinet to discuss next stages of offensive Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed at least 30 people in and around Gaza City, local health authorities said, as a 20-boat humanitarian aid flotilla carrying activists including Greta Thunberg set sail from Barcelona for the stricken territory. Authorities said the toll from Israeli tank and gunfire included 13 people who died trying to get food near a distribution site in the Gaza Strip, two in a house in Gaza City and 15, including five children, in a strike on a residential building on Saturday. title: Norway signs £10bn deal for anti-submarine warships built in UK
summary: MoD says agreement will support 4,000 jobs and ‘significantly strengthen Nato’s northern flank’ Norway has agreed a £10bn deal that will see anti-submarine warships built in the UK, as the two countries plan joint operations in northern Europe to deal with increased Russian activity . The Ministry of Defence (MoD) said the agreement to build Type 26 frigates is the UK’s biggest ever warship export deal by value, and Norway’s biggest defence procurement deal. Continue reading...
